tour.step1Body: This is your client workspace. In about a minute, we'll show you how to file your first ticket. Press Escape at any time to dismiss the tour.
tour.step2Body: Click Tickets in the side menu to see all your open requests and their status.
tour.step3Body: This button opens the new-ticket form. Use it to report bugs, ask for support, or request a new feature.
tour.step4Body: Summarise your request in one sentence. The more specific, the faster the team can act on it.
tour.step5Body: Explain what happens, what you expected, and the steps to reproduce if relevant. You can attach screenshots and files.
tour.step6Body: Low, Medium, High or Critical. Keep Critical for production blockers — it triggers the fastest SLA.
tour.step7Body: Hit Send to file the ticket. You'll get an email on every update.
tour.step8Body: Click your avatar to open My profile: edit your info, change language, manage password, export RGPD data, or sign out. You can replay this tour anytime via the Help button just to the left.

rgpd.pageIntro: In accordance with articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you can access, export, request deletion and exercise your other rights from this page.
rgpd.exportIntro: Download all your personal data in a structured (JSON), commonly used and machine-readable format.
rgpd.exportExclusionsNote: Security logs (audit_logs), sessions and internal tokens are not included, in accordance with article 15.4 (rights and freedoms of third parties) and article 32 (security of processing).
rgpd.rightAccess: Access (art. 15) — obtain a copy of your data via the export above.
rgpd.rightRectification: Rectification (art. 16) — correct inaccurate data from your profile or by email.
rgpd.rightErasure: Erasure (art. 17) — request deletion of your account (form below).
rgpd.rightLimitation: Limitation (art. 18) — restrict certain processing, on request.
rgpd.rightPortability: Portability (art. 20) — retrieve your data in a structured format (JSON export above).
rgpd.rightOpposition: Objection (art. 21) — object to processing based on legitimate interest.
rgpd.contactDpo: For any question or exercise of a right, contact the privacy officer. Response within 1 month.
rgpd.deletionIntro: This request will be forwarded to the privacy officer who will process it manually within 1 month. Some data may be retained for legal obligations (accounting, security).
rgpd.reasonPlaceholder: E.g.: I no longer use the service, I want to switch providers…
rgpd.deletionLegalNote: Submitting this request triggers a 1-month legal response period (extendable to 3 months in case of complexity, art. 12.3 GDPR). You will receive a reply by email.
rgpd.requestSubmitted: Request submitted. The privacy officer has been notified.
rgpd.requestError: An error occurred. Please retry or contact support.
